text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', 'Plus Jakarta Sans Variable', 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #b4c2b8

g.text: Closing the terminal changes nothing: the marker is on disk. Reopen the folder and the session continues from where it stopped.

text.style: font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', 'Plus Jakarta Sans Variable', 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #f2f7f3

g.text: Nothing is ever discarded. A session too small to convert waits in _unconverted, is read in next time, and converts when it is worth a memory.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Commit Mono', 'Cascadia Code', 'Consolas', 'SF Mono', 'DejaVu Sans Mono'; text-anchor: start; fill: #7f9188

g.text: the threshold is 4,000 NEW tokens since the last save, not the size of the whole session
